question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

How time flies!
solution:
The correct answer is **'Time seems to move quickly'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'How time flies!' **is **'Time seems to move quickly'.**
 
• **How time flies! **is used to say that time passes quickly. (यह कहने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है कि समय जल्दी बीत जाता है)
 
 
• *Example: Your son is in high school already? My, **how time flies!***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Time seems to move quickly.*
